title: The Matter Mystery
intro: This quiz follows Nia and Caleb as they discover what matter is and how solids, liquids, and gases behave.

choices: Anything that gives off light
Anything that has mass and takes up space
Only things that can be seen
Only solids and liquids
questions.explanation: Matter is anything that has mass and takes up space.

choices: It spreads out to fill all available space
It takes the shape of its container
It keeps its own shape
It has no mass
questions.explanation: A solid keeps its own shape.

questions.prompt: What happens when water is poured from a tall glass into a short cup?
choices: It keeps the shape of the tall glass
It takes the shape of the short cup
It becomes a gas
It stops being matter
questions.explanation: When water is poured into a short cup, it takes the shape of the short cup.

choices: It keeps a fixed shape
It stays only at the bottom of a container
It spreads out to fill the space around it
It cannot move
questions.explanation: A gas spreads out to fill the space around it.

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes a change of state?
choices: Ice can melt into liquid water
Water stops being matter when it evaporates
Gas cannot change back into a liquid
A solid can never change form
questions.explanation: Ice can melt into liquid water, which is a change of state.
